user.title: Homeo
user.description: Homeo runs the rules in the `homeo` folder of your configuration directory (files ending in `.homeo`).

data.dry_run: Dry run: log what the rules would do instead of doing it

compile_error.title: Errors in Homeo rules: {file}
compile_error.description:
`{file}` couldn't be loaded. The previous version of the file keeps running until these are fixed:

```
{errors}
```

machine_stopped.title: Homeo state machine stopped: {name}
machine_stopped.description:
State machine `{name}` (in `{file}`) went round in a loop in one step: {loop}. Homeo stopped it, so it stays in its current state and ignores its rules.

It starts again when you pick a state for `select.homeo_{name}`, or when the rules are reloaded (for example by saving `{file}`). To stop it happening again, change the rules so that no state leads straight back to itself.

explain.name: Explain
explain.description: Shows why a rule gives its current result: each arm's condition and the values it depends on.

target.name: Target
target.description: A bound entity or attribute (`fan.bathroom`, `climate.living.temperature`), a state machine (`house` or `select.homeo_house`), or a `let` name.
